fixed.explanation: In parseRawCookie, Expires and Max-Age both write cookie.expires in attribute order, so a later past Expires overrides an earlier Max-Age. Max-Age also uses parseInt, which accepts non-integer strings like "10abc". I track whether a valid Max-Age was seen, make Expires skip in that case, and validate Max-Age with /^-?\d+$/.
